author: Fextralife
description:
Mortal Shell 2 All Shells Ranked - Which Shell is Right For You?
In this video, I'm going to be talking about the eight shells of Mortal Shell two and helping you make a decision about which one to use. You won't get them all right away in the game. You can't choose from them at the beginning. So some of these you will probably use until you find the shell that you want. But this video is designed to give you an overview of how each shell plays. If there's an element that it synergizes with more than others, and what you should be considering when selecting that shell. I do have builds coming for every single shell out there that go more in-depth on how I play that shell, but if you're just looking for the general combat mechanics on how a shell works, this is the video for you.
